the respondent’s mother was aboriginal, he had come to identify as an aboriginal, and he suffered from FASD

had a devastating and enduring impact on the victim and her family

crime_highlights: who committed a series of violent offences on a number of different victims in a relatively short period of time

the appellant’s repeated attempts to obstruct the course of justice by trying to dissuade a victim from testifying against him and when that failed, attempting to have another inmate assault the victim
in one of the attacks, the appellant used a weapon
rationale_highlights: There was a thorough Gladue report before the court, which sets out the appellant’s tragic and difficult life
The sentencing judge took the contents of the report into consideration
note: Joint submission; Gladue report only shaped institution recommendation, no reduction
